context: useNotificationSettings loads a user's notification preferences and now adds an includeRead filter and a markAsRead action.
explanation: The effect's dependency array was changed from [userId] to [filters], but filters is a plain object literal recreated on every render. Since the effect calls setSettings, every fetch response triggers a re-render, which creates a new filters object, which re-triggers the effect — an infinite fetch loop. Fix: depend on the primitive values (filters.userId, filters.includeRead) or memoize filters with useMemo.
